summary_of_change:

Over the past four consecutive quarters, the business demonstrated durable cash generation and operational discipline, generating $2,371.0 million in net revenue in the latest quarter (+7.0% YoY) and anchoring an annualized revenue run-rate of $9,484.0 million. Unit economics remain among the strongest in global retail. Management maintained strict full-price discipline, refusing to dilute the franchise through broad-based promotional discounting and confining clearance cadence to its established 'We Made Too Much' digital portal. Inventories fell 14% YoY to $1,400.0 million, demonstrating healthy inventory turns and working capital control.

Capital allocation has been disciplined: with zero long-term funded debt and $1,600.0 million in cash and equivalents, Lululemon generated over $1.3 billion in trailing free cash flow and returned $1.6 billion to shareholders via open-market repurchases over the past four quarters ($583.7 million in the latest quarter alone), steadily shrinking the share base at depressed valuations.
